Across-shuffle aggregation: Algorithm 1 variance decomposition + Cauchy.

Source: R/aggregate.R
dot-aggregate_shuffles.Rd

Given S per-shuffle (psi_hat, sigma_hat) pairs,

Usage

.aggregate_shuffles(psi_hats, sigma_hats, n_samples, alpha = 0.05)

Details

psi = mean_s psi_hat var_total = mean_s (sigma_hat^2 + (psi_hat - psi)^2) se = sqrt(var_total / n) t_stat = psi / se p_value = one-sided upper-tail p-value under t_n-1

Per-shuffle one-sided p-values are also produced from a standard-normal approximation and fed into the Cauchy combination test.
